_comment: Canned /feed/api/* payloads for `node test/harness.js --offline`. The rows deliberately mix field shapes: `feed` carries the schema the bridge was written against, `since` carries the renamed/incident-shaped variants (transcript_clean, transcript_snippet, epoch start_time) that src/pkjs/index.js reads through its `pick` candidate lists. Both must render a complete row on the watch.

calls.transcript: Show me out with Utah plate on 800 North, one occupant.
Structure fire reported, heavy smoke showing from the rear.

calls.transcript_clean: Rollover on southbound I-15 near the Orem exit, lanes blocked.

calls.transcript_snippet: Checking the welfare of an occupant at the listed address.
